content.text: You’ve written an ebook. You’ve designed a cover. You’ve priced it to sell. But when you try to launch, the payment platforms reject you. Stripe isn’t available in Kenya. PayPal restricts your account. Gumroad flags your IP. This isn’t a failure of your product—it’s a failure of infrastructure. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this. It removes intermediaries. It gives you direct ownership of your payment pipeline, delivery system, and customer data. No platform can shut you down. No geography can block you. This guide walks you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-19|deploying]] a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-ebook-delivery-after-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-8|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]|The Complete]] ebook store from Kenya, using tools you own, on infrastructure designed to bypass geographic restrictions. By the end, you’ll have a live store that accepts crypto payments from anywhere, delivers files instantly, and operates entirely under your control.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail because they centralize control. Stripe decides which countries can use it. PayPal freezes accounts without warning. Gumroad’s terms change overnight. Sovereign infrastructure decentralizes. It uses GitHub Pages for hosting—free, global, and uncensorable. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic—fast, serverless, and cost-effective. Supabase stores orders securely, while Google Drive delivers files directly to buyers. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. This stack is permissionless. No platform approves your business. No geography restricts your reach. You deploy, you own, you operate. The infrastructure is pressure-tested in regions like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm. It’s built to work where platforms fail.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Start with your ebook files—PDF, EPUB, or MOBI. Prepare a product description, pricing, and any upsells. Choose your cryptocurrency payment network—BSC, Solana, or TRON are recommended for fees under $0.10 per transaction. Set up a NOWPayments account to generate payment links and webhooks. Create a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting. If using Supabase, sign up for a free tier. Gather your domain (optional) and email for customer communication. Finally, decide on your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity or Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features. The Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints and templates if you plan to build yourself. Ensure your tools are ready before deployment—this infrastructure is modular, but each piece must fit.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with NOWPayments. Create a payment link for your ebook and configure the webhook to trigger file delivery. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery—when payment confirms on-chain, the script sends the download link to the buyer’s email. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring the file is private but accessible via a signed URL. Test the pipeline end-to-end: simulate a payment, verify the webhook fires, and confirm the file delivers. This pipeline is your core commerce engine. It’s lightweight, automatic, and entirely under your control. No platform touches your transactions or customer data.
Sovereign infrastructure removes platforms—you own the pipeline.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Link your payment button to the NOWPayments invoice. Test the live flow: purchase your ebook using a test wallet, verify the payment confirms, and ensure the file delivers. Once confirmed, share your store link. Promote it through your network, social media, or email list. Monitor transactions in Supabase or Google Sheets. Respond to customer inquiries directly—no platform mediates communication. Your first sale proves the infrastructure works. It’s not a workaround—it’s a permanent solution. You’ve removed geographic barriers. You’re now operating on a global scale, from Kenya to anywhere.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the core infrastructure live, scale by adding products. Use the same pipeline for courses, templates, or software. Optimize for conversions: A/B test pricing, refine your sales page, and add upsells. Expand payment options by integrating additional cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments. Secure your domain with SPF/DKIM/DMARC to protect customer communication. Monitor costs—this stack is designed to scale without recurring fees. As revenue grows, reinvest in marketing or new products. The infrastructure is yours to modify. No platform limits your growth. No geography restricts your reach. You’ve built a sovereign commerce engine. It’s time to expand.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

To sell ebooks from Kenya without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Automate the payment-to-delivery pipeline with webhooks. Test the flow, go live, and promote your store. This infrastructure removes geographic restrictions, gives you full data ownership, and operates without platform intermediaries.
Crypto payments bypass geographic restrictions entirely.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your ebook files and product details. 2. Choose a low-fee crypto network (BSC, Solana, TRON). 3. Set up NOWPayments for payment processing. 4. Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation. 5. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Upload your ebook to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test the payment-to-delivery pipeline end-to-end. 8. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 9. Promote your store and monitor transactions. 10. Scale by adding products and optimizing conversions.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are pre-configured for deployment. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. No coding required—just follow the instructions.
What if my customers don’t use cryptocurrency?
Educate them. Provide a simple guide with your purchase link. Most buyers adopt crypto when it’s their only option. Networks like BSC and TRON have fees under $0.10, making them accessible.
How do I handle refunds?
Since you control the pipeline, issue refunds manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly to manage expectations.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This infrastructure is designed for digital products only. Physical goods require shipping integration, which introduces geographic dependencies.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, your store remains live—payments simply pause until service resumes. Your infrastructure is decoupled from any single provider.
